ghosts.title: The Region Marked Blank on the Map
ghosts.body: This piece once tried to argue that blank space and omission carry more than language itself — until the author concluded that the finest proof would be for the piece to vanish on its own.

ghosts.title: A Table of Contents Never Sent
ghosts.body: This piece was meant to lay out a list, but the first entry was never finished, and without it the rest lost any reason to exist.

ghosts.title: A Note Revised One Time Too Many
ghosts.body: Every revision made the previous version look less accurate, until the latest one decided it would be better to say nothing at all.

ghosts.title: Written Tomorrow, Published Yesterday
ghosts.body: This piece set out to examine temporal dislocation, and in the process mislaid the very moment it was supposed to appear.

ghosts.title: Draft Seven
ghosts.body: The first six were all judged “not yet the right time.” This one decided to stop waiting, and skipped publication instead.

ghosts.title: For Whoever Just Opened This Link
ghosts.body: This piece exists entirely because you clicked it — and by the time you did, it had already decided to leave.

ghosts.title: A Passage That Could Have Been Shorter
ghosts.body: The author only ever meant to say one sentence, and somewhere along the way decided that even that one was unnecessary.

ghosts.title: Latitude Blank, Longitude Blank
ghosts.body: This is a piece about “here.” Unfortunately “here,” upon verification, does not exist.

ghosts.title: Memory, Still Loading
ghosts.body: This piece has been stuck at “generating” for so long that it no longer remembers what it meant to say.

Security.title: Captcha
Security.description: Add a human verification step at key entry points to block bots from brute-forcing logins, flooding emails, or spamming applications.

toggle.title: Enable human verification
toggle.description: When off, no entry point performs human verification.

provider.label: Provider
provider.hint: Keys are stored separately for each provider; switching providers keeps previously entered keys, and only the selected one takes effect.

siteKey.label: Site Key
siteKey.placeholder: Enter the public key from the provider's dashboard
siteKey.hint: A public key visible to visitors; exposure poses no risk.

secretKey.label: Secret Key
secretKey.placeholder: Enter the server-side key from the provider's dashboard
secretKey.hint: Stored on the server only; do not share it. If leaked, others could forge verification results.

minScore.label: Score threshold
minScore.hint: Applies to reCAPTCHA v3 only: instead of a pass/fail result, it returns a 0–1 confidence score where closer to 1 means more likely human. A higher threshold is stricter. Start with the default 0.5 and adjust based on real scores from the test below.

test.label: Key Test
test.hint: Whether the keys work can only be confirmed by submitting a real verification to the provider. The widget below is what visitors will see — complete it, then click Test. This does not modify saved settings.
test.needToken: Please complete the verification above first
test.passed: Verification passed; the keys are valid

errors.unknown: Verification failed; the provider returned no reason
errors.invalid-input-secret: Invalid Secret Key. Check for missing characters, or that the keys were not swapped
errors.invalid-input-response: Invalid verification token. Complete the verification again, or confirm both keys belong to the same site
errors.missing-input-response: No verification token received; complete the verification above first
errors.timeout-or-duplicate: The token has expired or was already used; complete the verification again
errors.bad-request: The provider rejected the request. Confirm both keys belong to the same site and the correct provider is selected
errors.invalid-widget-id: The Site Key and Secret Key belong to different sites
errors.low-score: The human check passed, but the score is below your threshold; lower the threshold and retry
errors.not-using-dummy-secret: A test credential was used, but the Secret Key is not the provider's test key
errors.request-failed: The server could not reach the provider; check the server's network or proxy settings

scenes.label: Verification Scenes
scenes.hint: Only the checked scenes require human verification; the rest are unaffected.
